8.3.16 StbM_SetCloningOffset
[SWS_StbM_91030] Definition of API function StbM_SetCloningOffset
Upstream requirements: RS_TS_00038
⌈
Service Name
StbM_SetCloningOffset
Syntax
Std_ReturnType StbM_SetCloningOffset (
StbM_SynchronizedTimeBaseType timeBaseId,
const StbM_TimeStampType* timeOffset
)
Service ID [hex]
0x32
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
timeBaseId
Time Base reference of the Destination Time Base
Parameters (in)
timeOffset
Offset value for cloning
Parameters (inout)
None
▽
△
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: successful.
E_NOT_OK: failed
Description
Sets an offset time that will be added to the synchronized time when cloning a Time Base.
Available via
StbM.h
⌋
[SWS_StbM_00627]
"Invalid Time Base Parameter" Development Error for
StbM_SetCloningOffset
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00386, SRS_BSW_00323
⌈If the switch StbMDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE, StbM_SetCloningOffset
shall report to DET the development error STBM_E_PARAM, if called with a parame-
ter timeBaseId, which
• is not configured or
• is within the reserved value range.
⌋
[SWS_StbM_00628]
"Service
Not
Supported"
Development
Error
for
StbM_SetCloningOffset
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00386, SRS_BSW_00323
⌈If the switch StbMDevErrorDetect is set to TRUE, StbM_SetCloningOffset
shall report to DET the development error STBM_E_SERVICE_NOT_SUPPORTED, if
called for a Time Base, which has no Source Time Base (refer to parameter StbM-
SourceTimeBase) configured.⌋
